review.note: Retracted in M41b: the motorway concessionaire founded in 1972 by Jorge de Brito, which built and runs most of the Portuguese network. The motorway programme of the 1980s and 1990s is a real consequence of accession to the Communities and would make a good record; the atlas does not hold it, and without it the company has nothing to be joined to.
